summary: Portable, backward-compatible execution-graph learning records are implemented across Rust graph production, lifecycle recording, graph edits, aggregation, persistence/sync, and Fractal Voice display. Final repository gates pass with 247 Rust tests, warning-free Clippy, rustfmt, and 68 Swift tests; excluded Apple release and generated dist scope was not changed.

acceptance.evidence: Producer and lifecycle fixtures in compile, decompose, work_builder, execute, project_file, orchestrate, and supervise assert stable structural fields, normalized dependencies, timestamps, executor metadata, attempts, outcomes, verification, artifact lineage, intervention, and truthful optional costs; final Rust suite passed 247/247.

learning_data controlled-enum and invariant tests cover the seven outcomes, twelve failure codes, unknown-value rejection, success/failure incompatibilities, terminal timestamps, verification consistency, and produced-before-consumed artifact validation; final Rust suite passed.

project_file and graph_store legacy migration and enriched round-trip fixtures preserve graph topology, identity, unknown compatible fields, and graph hashes while safely defaulting absent learning data; final Rust suite passed.

execute, project_file, run_control, checkpoint, and cross-boundary fixtures cover ready/checkout/start, retry/reopen, execution and verification failures, timeout, success, cancellation, stale release/resume, artifact production/consumption, and human completion with monotonic timestamps and preserved attempts; final Rust suite passed.

amendments 8/8, harness_evolution 2/2, and supervise 7/7 focused tests passed, covering split, reroute, cancel, dependency edits, autonomous evolution, verified before-hashes, ordered compact events, structural retirement, and downstream eventual-effect updates.

Deterministic learning_data 4/4 and project_file 15/15 aggregation fixtures passed for sequential, parallel, retry, reopen, failure, cancellation, dead/unused nodes, human completion, PRD criterion IDs, critical path, concurrency, costs, coverage denominator, and evidence-based early-stop/expansion flags.

learning_data, project_file, and graph_store boundary tests reject forbidden credential/chain-of-thought-style fields and oversized strings while serialized fixtures retain only bounded notes, evidence_refs, and compact artifact IDs; final Rust suite passed.

project_file, graph_store, project_sync, checkpoint, harness_evolution, and cross-boundary fixtures verify local persistence, evolved-child hashes, resume recovery, canonical validation, and upload payload preservation without dropping enriched learning records; final Rust suite passed.

swift test --package-path macos/FractalVoice passed 68/68 tests, including legacy, fully enriched, partial, unknown-forward-compatible, BuildCoordinator, HUD, node attempt/outcome/verification, and graph completion-summary fixtures without false corruption states.

Final gates passed: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo test --no-fail-fast (247 passed); cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; swift test --package-path macos/FractalVoice (68 passed). git diff --name-only contains no dist-* release bundle, signing/notarization, archive, DMG, ZIP, or Apple submission path.

risks: The workspace contained substantial unrelated pre-existing modifications and untracked dist directories; the acceptance audit relied on the final diff path inventory and scoped tests, and no dist-* path appears in the tracked diff.

Fractal's scheduler briefly launched downstream repair workers before an externally checked-out dependency completed; conflicting processes were stopped through Fractal pause, ownership was restored atomically, and the final full Rust and Swift gates validate the reconciled workspace.
No signing, notarization, packaging, release archive generation, or Apple submission was performed, so those excluded deployment paths remain unvalidated by design.
